headline: Sensex gains over 300 points as Nifty holds above 23,400 amid easing crude oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Crude oil prices eased below $99 per barrel, boosting investor sentiment
Positive global market cues, including higher European shares, lifted sentiment
ADB raised India's FY27 economic growth forecast to 7%
Buying in metal, FMCG, and PSU Bank stocks supported benchmark indices
whatHappening: Sensex gained up to 400 points while Nifty moved above the 23,400 mark
RBI absorbed ₹75,026 crore through an overnight VRRR auction amid liquidity surplus
Snapdeal parent AceVector and NSE IPO listings remained key highlights in primary markets
EV maker Ultraviolette raised $85 million for production expansion and US market entry
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded higher today, buoyed by dipping crude oil prices and positive global market cues. Sectoral gains in metal, FMCG, and PSU Bank shares along with top gainers like Kotak Mahindra Bank and Bajaj Finance drove the market momentum. Sentiment was further bolstered by ADB raising India's FY27 growth forecast to 7%.
